verdicts.reason: A shrinks the original instead of reflowing it: 'Saturday 21 June', the chips and the legal text sit only a few pixels from the left edge (the legal line touches it), the headline is small for a tall format, a large dead band sits between the CTA and the footer, and the 'ALL AGES' chip text runs together. B reflows properly: the headline wraps to two large lines, there is a consistent 40px left margin, and the phone sits below the chips so the layout reads top to bottom. Its flaws: the subtitle sits too close to 'Saturday 21 June', the CTA and URL line are off-centre to the left, and the placeholder image box is jammed right next to the URL line.
